== Trivia ==
*'''Elise''' has a number in Roman numerals next to her name, referencing the amount of times the player has entered the [[Rift Dimension]].
**This is also in the description of {{Item|Rift Necklace}} and is updated with every visit.
**If the player has never entered the Rift yet, her name is simply {{mctxt|d|Elise}}.<!-- /viewrecipe RIFT_TROPHY_WYLDLY_SUPREME -->
**If the player has entered the Rift {{Green|4,000}} or more times, her name will become {{mctxt|d|Elise TOO_HIGH_NUMBER}}.
*'''Elise's''' dialogue {{mctxt|f|Return in 3-5 business days}} is a reference to the {{NPCSprite|Wizard}}'s dialogue before the Rift update.
